title: An explicit R-flat complex computing RHom between a pseudo-coherent object and an object of finite tor dimension, and its base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The statement produces an explicit complex computing RHom_A(K, L) for a flat ring map R -> A, a pseudo-coherent K and an L of finite tor dimension over R: it exhibits representatives P and F, states that the Hom complex E is bounded below with R-flat terms representing RHom, that base change of E computes RHom of the base changed objects, and that under finite presentation of the map and R-perfectness of L the terms can be taken finitely presented (statement lines 22039-22062). The proof has to make the choices work simultaneously: pseudo-coherence gives the bounded above complex of finite free modules, bounded tor dimension gives boundedness and, after truncation below the tor amplitude interval, the R-flatness of the terms, and then the flatness of the terms of F is what makes base change commute with the Hom complex term by term, which is the computation displayed at the end (proof lines 22064-22101). The three cited results are the existence of the bounded representative, the identification of the Hom complex with RHom, and the base change comparison; all three are carried as navigation stubs.
